Kit summary

Tearing ArrowBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 90% ATK DMG to a single enemy and deals extra 90% ATK DMG. This extra DMG is considered as [Bleed] DMG.
Carved Bow Lv.1Each time Lysander casts Tearing Arrow or casts it to pursue and attack or counterattack, there is a 40% chance to strengthen Tearing Arrow this time by increasing its DMG dealt by 50%. If Tearing Arrow failed to be strengthened, Lysander will gain 1 layer of [Spell Charge]; If it is strengthened successfully, all layers of [Spell Charge] will be removed. Each layer of [Spell Charge] will increase the chance of strengthening Tearing Arrow by 15%. The chance of landing this effect is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.
Hunter InstinctPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Lysander gains 5 layers of [Ambush] at the beginning of each wave. At the end of all allies' (excluding self) turns, he gains 1 layer of [Ambush] and casts Tearing Arrow to pursue and attack a random enemy. [Ambush]: Each layer increases 2.8% Basic Attack DMG, up to 15 layers. Lysander loses 5 layers at the end of his turn.
Carved Bow Lv.2The layers of [Ambush] granted by Hunter Instinct will be doubled if Lysander has less than 10 layers of [Ambush]. Each layer of [Ambush] additionally increases Lysander's [Bleed] DMG by 2%.
Under ControlPassive
When a battle starts, reduces self SPD to 1500 if self SPD is higher than 1500. Afterward, 0.14% of Lysander's initial SPD between 1500 and 2000 will be converted to Mastery (up to 70%).
Invisible HuntingActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 170% ATK DMG to a single enemy and deals extra 170% ATK DMG. Afterward, grants self [Stealth] for 1 turn. This extra DMG is considered as [Bleed] DMG.
Carved Bow Lv.3If Lysander has 6/10/14 layers of [Ambush], increases DMG of Invisible Hunting by 100%/200%/400% when he is casting Invisible Hunting.
